summary: The PR fixes the issue with stackplot not respecting the Axes cycler, but introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect.

issues.description: The use of itertools.cycle can be replaced with a more Pythonic approach, such as using the cycle function from the matplotlib.cycler module.
The change introduces a minor style inconsistency by using the next function to get the next color from the cycle, instead of using the _get_lines.get_next_color method directly.
The PR does not add any new tests, but the existing tests do pass, so this is not a major concern.
